title: Chocolate Meltaways

directions: Cream butter. Add powdered sugar and vanilla.
Stir in sifted flour and salt.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler or microwave. Add to dough and mix until well blended.
Drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 250°F for 60 minutes. Do not underbake.

notes: Doubles well. According to family legend, these come out best in a gas oven.
